identity: Speargrass Reach cuts the Throng's spears from its grass; vultures, tigers and a goblin banner-broker cut into the harvest.

quests.title: Still Using Those Ankles
quests.text: Kill eight Dust-Stinger Scorpions after dark on the {name:plains}, {zone_area:plains}; they burrow into the cut grass and our cutters come home limping and swearing at every shadow. Tell those scorpions my cutters are still using their ankles, if you think they will listen.

quests.title: Optional: Count the Cutters Home
quests.text: I count every cutter who leaves the Wellhold, and lately the returning count has been short. Kill eight Tallgrass Tigers by day in the {name:tallgrass}, {zone_area:tallgrass}. Let our people keep their eyes on their work for once.

quests.title: Promises Outlast Breath
quests.text: The undead of Nhal Veyr buy our spears, and I have never had to ask twice for a favour they owed. Travel to their city and speak to Ossa Quietregister on our behalf. Mind your manners; a bare jaw can still take offence.

quests.title: The Yard Eats Steel
quests.text: Redpick Yard has worn out another pick, and the sorting trays are trying to follow it into the scrap heap. Bring me four Steel Bars so we can keep working. The rock will still be here tomorrow, but I would prefer less of it.

quests.title: Optional: Put the Claws to Work
quests.text: The smith has an idea for our pick tips, and for once I like the sound of it. Bring me three Shearing Cat Claws from Tallgrass Tigers in the {name:tallgrass}; hunt them by day. Getting the claws is your part, and convincing the smith to stop talking and start fitting them is mine.

quests.title: Bounty: Stripes on the Payroll
quests.text: Tallgrass Tigers keep prowling the {name:hunting_grounds} by day, and chasing them off is eating into our work. Kill six and return for the yard's bounty. The job opens again twenty minutes after you collect; I can pay for dead tigers or lost shifts, and I prefer the tigers.

quests.title: Optional: Teeth Beyond the Watch
quests.text: When dark falls, Dustpack Hyenas gather in the {name:hunting_grounds}, {zone_area:hunting_grounds}, and our patrols hear every hungry mouth. Kill eight at night for Cutgrass Watch. I would sleep better knowing fewer teeth were waiting for the next patrol.

quests.title: Our Colours Are Not for Sale
quests.text: Goblin Banner-Broker Rakk is selling our stolen war banners back to us from the {name:goblin_camp}, {dir_from_giver:goblin_camp}. Kill eight of his Ore-Thieving Goblins or Rubble Goblin Slingers in any mix, and kill Rakk himself. Orcs bled beneath those colours; he will not haggle over them.

quests.title: Stand Where the Ash Falls
quests.text: Vaska Ashlistener needs fighters at Ashveil Watch on Blackwind Rise, where the Throng is fighting to hold its ground. Go and report to Vaska. I have watched you protect the people who put spears in our hands; now carry that strength to the line.
